pointcast.label: PointCast blockchain
pointcast.note: PointCast has a local development prototype. No public node, genesis or certificate signer is configured for this collection. First-collector certificates are a local rehearsal proposal; none are issued or promised. The planned 1 tez purchase would buy only the Tezos token.

certificate.price: free, not part of the 1 tez purchase
certificate.trigger: applied gallery sale, 2 successor Tezos blocks

disclosure: Preview only. Planned artwork price: 1 tez. Purchase, minting and listing are unavailable. Network fees are additional and currently unknown; the signing wallet must show its estimate. No tokens, stock, ownership or completed sales are asserted.
